title: A developer automated their entire job search, submitted over 700 applications, and got hired
description:
A developer automated their entire job search, submitted over 700 applications, and got hired. Career-Ops is the open-source system they built. It scans career pages across 45-plus tech companies including Stripe, Anthropic, and OpenAI. Finds matching roles, rewrites your CV with 14 skill modes to fit each specific position, and generates ATS-optimized PDFs via Playwright. Ships with a terminal dashboard to monitor batch processing in real time.

https://github.com/santifer/career-ops

#github #opensource
